title: Upward Technologies vs lemlist
content_html:
Upward Technologies and lemlist serve different needs. lemlist is built for sales teams running outbound campaigns across email, LinkedIn, calls, WhatsApp and SMS from one workflow. Upward Technologies builds custom software, automation and AI agents to take manual, repetitive work off teams across their entire operation, and hosts and runs what it builds. If your team's main challenge is outbound sales execution, lemlist is the focused choice. If your team loses hours to retyping data between systems that almost fit, or to steps that repeat the same way every day, Upward Technologies may be the better fit.

What lemlist is good at

lemlist describes itself as a platform for running outbound sales. According to its website, lemlist runs automated campaigns across email, LinkedIn, calls, WhatsApp and SMS from one workflow.

The platform includes a B2B lead database. lemlist also offers a Deliverability Hub to help keep emails landing in inboxes when sending at scale across multiple mailboxes and domains.

For integrations, lemlist connects to the CRMs HubSpot, Salesforce and Pipedrive. It integrates with the VoIP tools Aircall and Ringover, and with Zapier, Make, n8n and Clay. lemlist supports Google, Microsoft and SMTP mailboxes for sending. lemlist offers a two-way sync with HubSpot for outbound activities and leads.

lemlist offers flexible billing options and includes a free trial period. The Enterprise plan has custom pricing.

What Upward Technologies does differently

Upward Technologies is a Dutch software company that builds custom software, automation and AI agents. It does not offer a pre-built platform for outbound sales. Instead, it works with teams to map their exact process, then builds software that fits how they already work. The company also builds AI agents to automate repetitive steps, integrates separate systems so data is entered once, and hosts and runs what it builds.

Upward Technologies starts every project with a three-week paid scoping phase. This phase maps your team's workflow, identifies which steps can be automated and which need a person's judgment, and produces a document you could take to another supplier. Only after that do you decide whether to move forward.

For sales and outreach, Upward Technologies offers Reach, a B2B outreach product, and GTM, an AI go-to-market tool that drafts posts, articles and news for a person to approve. These are separate products, sold on their own. Upward Technologies also builds custom outreach workflows when a team's process does not fit a standard tool. For example, if your outreach needs to pull live data from your CRM, check inventory before sending, or route responses to different team members based on content, custom software can do that. A pre-built platform usually cannot.

Upward Technologies also works on problems beyond sales. It builds custom software for operations, finance and IT teams. It integrates ERP and CRM systems so data flows between them without retyping. It builds client portals, document workflows, and automation for any repetitive step that has a clear input and output. It handles hosting, support and updates after go-live, so your IT team does not have to.

Which one should you pick

Pick lemlist if: Your team runs outbound sales campaigns and needs a platform to automate email, LinkedIn, calls and SMS in one workflow. lemlist's lead database, deliverability tools and integrations with HubSpot, Salesforce and Pipedrive make it the natural choice for this use case.

Pick Upward Technologies if: Your team's bottleneck is not outbound campaigns alone, but a mix of manual work across systems. For example, if your sales team spends time retyping leads from one place to another, or if your operations team loses hours to spreadsheets and disconnected tools, or if you need custom automation for a process that no standard tool covers. Upward Technologies starts with a three-week scoping phase to map exactly what to build, so you are not guessing.

Pick both if: You run outbound campaigns in lemlist and also need custom software to handle the follow-up process, data integration, or reporting that lemlist does not cover. Upward Technologies can build the custom layer around lemlist, and integrate it with your other systems.

FAQ

Is lemlist or Upward Technologies better for B2B outreach?

lemlist is built for B2B outreach campaigns. It includes a lead database, campaign automation across email, LinkedIn, calls, WhatsApp and SMS, and integrations with HubSpot, Salesforce and Pipedrive. If your team's main need is to run outbound campaigns, lemlist is the faster choice. Upward Technologies builds custom outreach workflows when your process needs data from your own systems or logic that a campaign platform does not support. See the best B2B outreach software guide for a full comparison of options.

Can Upward Technologies replace lemlist?

Upward Technologies can build custom outreach automation, but it does not offer a pre-built campaign platform with a lead database. If you need lemlist's campaign features, Upward Technologies would not replace it. Upward Technologies is useful where lemlist ends: integrating outreach data with your CRM, routing responses to the right team, or automating the follow-up steps after a campaign. Many teams use lemlist for campaigns and Upward Technologies for the custom logic around it.

Does lemlist integrate with other tools?

Yes. According to its website, lemlist integrates with HubSpot, Salesforce and Pipedrive for CRM, with Aircall and Ringover for VoIP, and with Zapier, Make, n8n and Clay for workflow automation. lemlist also supports Google, Microsoft and SMTP mailboxes.

Can I use Upward Technologies to build custom outreach software?

Yes. Upward Technologies builds custom software for any repetitive process, including outreach. If your team's outreach needs to pull live data from your CRM, check inventory before sending, route responses to different team members, or connect to systems lemlist does not support, Upward Technologies can build that. The process starts with a three-week paid scoping phase to map your workflow and decide what to build.

What is the difference between AI go-to-market tools and outbound campaign platforms?

Campaign platforms like lemlist focus on sending messages at scale. AI go-to-market tools like GTM focus on helping one person or a small team draft content. Some teams use both: lemlist to send campaigns, and GTM to draft the messages. See the best AI go-to-market software comparison for more detail.

How does Upward Technologies pricing compare to lemlist?

lemlist publishes its pricing on its website. Upward Technologies does not publish pricing because every project is custom. The cost depends on the scope of what you build, how much hosting and support you need, and whether you run AI on your own hardware or Upward-hosted servers. A three-week paid scoping phase comes first, and ends with a clear project brief and a go or no-go decision. This means you know what you are building and what it will cost before any code is written.
